Name: Netflix Inc
Description: Netflix, Inc. is a leading American over-the-top content platform and production company, headquartered in Los Gatos, California. Established in 1997 by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph, Netflix revolutionized the media landscape with its subscription-based streaming service, providing users access to an extensive library of films and television series, including critically acclaimed original content. As a pioneer in the streaming industry, the company continues to expand globally, leveraging innovative distribution strategies and investment in original programming to enhance viewer engagement and drive subscriber growth. With a commitment to transforming entertainment consumption, Netflix stands at the forefront of the digital media revolution.
